༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i lho sgo'i cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i lho sgo'i cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo mahā sarba dzñā dar+sha dharmā ka ra ya/ 'dir dus kyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i lho sgo'i cho ga ni/ 'dus pa dang gshed skor sogs kyi dus tha ma'i cho ga rnams ni ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi lugs zangs mar sbyar bar mdzad 'dug pa rgyud ni rgyud gzhan gyis rtogs par bya ba yin pas/ shi nas ngan song sbyong ba'i las ni sbyong rgyud kho na bzhin bya dgos pas don no/ /de'i phyir legs pa'i bus/ dus 'khor gyi lho sgo'i sngags rnams kyang ngan song sbyong rgyud du bkod pas 'dir yang de bzhin bya'o/ /lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'ang 'phags yul du grong khyer gyi lho sgo ni gshin rje gnas pa'i phyogs yin pas ro bskyal ba'i skabs ma gtogs mi phye zhing der dgos pa'i cho ga yin pas dkyil 'khor lho sgor byed pa sogs ni rdzun bshad do/ /de nas rten gang yin pa la bgegs sbyangs pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lor gsal bar gyur/ bgegs gtor ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra= oṃ āḥbadz+ra sur+ya= oṃ hūṃ badz+ra ā= oṃ hoḥsarba= 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ tshe las 'das pa a mu ka zhes bya ba la las kyi dbang gis 'chi kha dang bar do dang tshe rabs gzhan thams cad du gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang*/ sdig pa sbyong zhing dge ba'i chos bskyed pa la bar du gcod pa dang*/ 'brel ba can shul na gnas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ shī gh+raṃ/ e daṃ ba ling*/ gṛh+ṇa/ gṛh+ṇa/ bhug twa/ bi twa/ krib tiṃ/ kri twa/ sarba satwa nāṃ/ shīn+taṃ/ tsit+tiṃ/ kri twa/ swa a ba ra swa s+tha naṃ gats+tsha gats+tsha swāhā 'i bar lan gsum brjod/ spro na khro bo spyan 'dren dang mchod bstod bya/ hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor chen po sogs bya/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka'=

dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyi= bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs 'khor bsrung ma drug cu'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi= bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis ch+gai mo zhes bya ba/ sogs nas/ gdon bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gnod sems zhi zhing dge ba'i sems dang ldan pas dmigs yul bsgrub bya 'di'i than 'khor du ma gnas par gzhan du songs shigagal te mi 'gro na ye shes kyi rdo rje 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar dgas par bya'o// gtor ma phyi rol tu dor rol mo'i sgra bsgrags gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brabs/ de nyid las 'phros pa'i rdo rje'i me dpung steng du 'og tu ljang khu dang sngon po/ shar dang mer nag po/ lho dang bden bral du dmar po/ byang dang dbang ldan du dkar po/ nub dang rlung du ser po 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba'i rdo rje rnams kyis sems can rnams la rnam par 'tshe bar byed pa'i bdud kyi tshogs phyogs bcu na gnas pa mtha' dag nges par bsregs nas bde ba chen po la 'god par bya'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥhrāḥhrāḥhrāḥhrāḥ sogs nas/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas rten bskyed pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dmigs rten tshe 'das ༵ch+gai mo zhes bya gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas gong bzhin las/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sogs nas/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis tshe 'das ch+gai mo zhes bya ba khams gsum gang na gnas shing rigs drug gang du skyes sam skye gnas bzhi gang du 'dug kyang skad cig thang cig yid tsam 'di nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig

lan gsum ltung ba slong ba'i rgyas/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ a pa na ye hūṃ/ zhes pas sdig pa bkug pa dang dral ba'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bī s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba ā pa ya bhan+dha ni pra mo k+ṣa ya/ sarba a pa ya ga ti bh+yaḥ sarba satwa naṃ sarba tā thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya traṭa/ gsum/ oṃ sarba bid sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas sdig pa sbyangs/ oṃ sarba bid drad/ oṃ badz+ra ban+dha dra tha/ oṃ sarba bid badz+ra adhi tiṣ+ṭha dzñā na sa ma ya hūṃ/ ngan song sbyongs/ dpral par oṃ/ snying khar hūṃ/ gtsug tor du haṃ/ lte bar hoḥ mgrin par āḥ gsang bar k+ṣaḥyig gis mtshan pa gyur/ snying po dang thams cad rigs pa'i rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ā pa ya bi shwa dha ne badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa ni bhasmi ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bh+rūṃ bi shwa dhā ya ā ba ra ṇa ni badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ druṃ bi shwa dha ya ā ba ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la dha ka dha ka ha na ha na sarba ā ba ra ṇa ni badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sruṃ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra sarba ā ba ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ ha ra ha ra sarba ā ba ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa sarba ā ba ra ṇa ni bi s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bi tra ba bi tra ba sarba a pa ya tad to ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tuṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams dang gzhan yang bzla zhing rdzas kyis brabs/ de nas lag len spros pa la dga' na dkyil 'khor khrus gsol bya ste/ ji ltar bltams pa= 'di ni khrus= de bzhin gshegs pa= de dag sku la= oṃ hūṃ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swāhā/ de nas de la sogs kyis gos zung phul/ de lta bus khrus chu de la bum nang du blug nas rten la khrus bya/

de yang*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ / sogs dang*/ chu bo drug gis sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang*/ /rang rgyal dag gis gzi brjid dang*/ /dgra bcom rnams kyi mthu dag dang*/ gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang*/ /shā ri'i bu'i shes rab dang*/ /mo'u 'gal bu yi rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /ma 'gags pa yi mig dang ni/ /'od srung sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*/ /kau di n+ya'i sngar thob dang*/ /kun dga' bo'i thos pa dang*/ /tshangs pa yi ni byams pa dang*/ /brgya byin gyi ni dbang rnams dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i yul rnams dang*/ /dbang phyug chen po'i stobs dag dang*/ /sde dpon rnams kyi mthu dag dang*/ /'phrog ma'i gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /de dag rnams kyi mthu dang gzis/ / ch+gai'i dug ni dug med shog/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// sogs dang*/ sa ni dug gi pha yin te/ /sa ni dug gi sogs brjod/ tshigs bcad de dag gi bar bar du snying po dang rtsa rig brjod cing bum chus bkru'o/ / mi 'khrugs rgyal po srid dang gti mug rnam sbyongs pa/ /mgon po yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i bkra shis pa/ /dge mnyam bsam med ldan pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /oṃ kaṃ kā ni sogs nas/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa ra ṇi me sarba satwa naṃ tsa swāhā/ sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi rgyan gyis brgyan mdzad cing*// yang dag sbyin mdzad 'gro ba'i don la mi bslu ba'i/ /rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis des na skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog/oṃ rat+ne rat+ne mahā rat+ne/ rat+na sām+bha be/ rat+ne ki rat+ne/ rat+na ma la bi shud+dhe shwa dha ya sarba pa paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sems can don la thugs ni rab tu dgod mdzad cing*// 'gro ba mtha' dag 'ching ba'i bcings las grol mdzad pa/ /thub mchog don yod grub pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/

/bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /oṃ ā mo gha a pra ti ha ta/ sarba a pa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ni ha ra ha ra hūṃ phaṭa/ bsam gtan ting 'dzin dam pa rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ /ye shes pad+ma'i steng bzhugs dpag med tshe ldan pa/ /tshe grangs med par byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /oṃ a mi te a mi tod bha we a mi ta saṃ bha we/ a mi ta bi krān te/ a mi ta ga mi ni ga ga na kīrti ka re sarba karma kle shak+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swāhā/ rnam par snang mdzad ye shes dam pa mtsho chen ldan// zla ba nya 'dra'i sku mnga' srid pa mthar phyin pa/ / dgongs pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis des ni skye rgu rnams la zhi byed shog /oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye mahā puṇ+ye a pa ra mī ta puṇ+ye a yur puṇ+ye dzñā na saṃ bha ro pa tsi ti u pa ka ri ṇi swāhā/ spro zhing nus na/ gang la ser sna rnam chags sogs yang pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdor byung ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis brjod/ de nas dpal dus 'khor yab yum la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs bcad dang*/ gtso bo'i rgyal ba sogs nas/ 'jigs las myur du bskyab tu gsol/ bar spyod 'jug las byung ba ltar dang*/ de nas dbang bskur ba'i mchod chog nyer mkho'i maṇ+ḍal phul/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ / zhes sogs nas/ gtso bo'i spyan sngar 'bul bar bgyi 'i bar dang*/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ / sogs nas/ cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ / bar dang dbang bskur ba'o/ /long skabs med na/ oṃ ā ī ṝ ū l̥̄ pañtsa dhā tu bi shud+dha ni swāhā/ sogs nas/ 'bras bu sa ni bdun pa thob gyur cig / zhes pa'i bar tsam bskyur kyang rung ngo*/ / rten bsgrub byar gsal ba la/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dmigs yul dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/

pa la mchod par bsam/ zas gos sogs bsangs sbyangs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya dang*/ gzi brjid tshad med sngags lan bdun gyis bsngos/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs kyi tshigs bcad la/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i gnas thob khyod la 'bul/ /zag med dga' bdes rtag tu tshim par shog /oṃ kā la tsakra rū pa ka ma gu ṇa sogs sngags bsgyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer byung*/ tshe 'das kyi phung khams skye mched 'khor ba'i chos thams cad ye shes chen po'i dbyings su sbyangs bar gyur/ dus 'khor snying po dang*/ rtsa rig lan gsum gyis me sbar zhing*/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i me/ /tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang*/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /ye shes snang bar 'bar gyur cig/phung po drug gi bud shing la/ /rgyal ba rigs drug me sbar ro/ /khams rnams lnga yi bud shing la/ /rdo rje ma lnga'i me= /las rlung bcu yi bud shing la/ /nus ma bcu yi me= /dbang yul drug gi bud shing la/ /sems dpa' sems ma'i me= /las dbang yul bcas bud shing la/ khro bo khro mo'i me= /lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la/ /rgyal ba sku gsum me sbar ro/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du/ /'gro ba'i don du spyod pa shog/ lam sbyangs pa ni/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen sogs nas/ bgrod par shog /oṃ rat+ne rat+ne mahā rat+ne rat+na sam+bha be rat+ne ki rat+ne rat+na mā la bi shud+dhe shwadha ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lam bstan pa ni/ pad+ma 'dam ky-is ma gos sogs nas/ skye bar shog /oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma saṃ bha be mahā su kha ba ti gats+tshan tu swāhā/ drin lan mchod stod byas la ched du brjod pa ni/ tshe 'das de nyid bde ba can du skyes de'i rgyu rkyen brtags pas slob dpon gyi cho ga'i mthu yin par shes nas 'di nyid du lhag ste slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa/

oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ stong nyid snying rje sogs kyis bstod/ ched du brjod pa ni/ e ma sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni// sngags kyi byin brlabs ya mtshan che/ /gang phyir mtshams med ltung ba yi/ /sems can lha gnas myur du skyes/ /e ma shākya mgon po yi// sangs rgyas mdzad pa ngo mtshar che/ /gang phyir ngan song ltung ba yi/ /sems can glog bzhin myur du grol/ /slar yang bde ba can du gshegs par gyur/ / de nas rgyud las/ sbyin bsreg gis sbyangs bar gsung pa rten gang yin pa rdzas gcig pa'i sbyin bsreg bya dgos pa de ltar na/ me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi ngo bor gyur/ snying po dang rtsa rig mthar ch+gai mo'i/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad da ha na bhasmin ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa bdun sogs bzlas nas til dang ming byang bsreg go /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog sogs bya'o/ /de ltar lho sgo'i cho ga rgyud sde spyi la sbyar rung ba'i gsang ba spyi'i cho ga 'di yang jo nang sgrol mgon zhabs kyi gsungs rgyun rim par brgyud pa'i ngag rgyun la gnas pa ltar karma tshe dbang kun khyab kyi bkod pa ste/ snying po mtha' yas kyis yi ger phab pa'o// / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i lho sgo'i cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 70--PAGE 71--PAGE 65-
